# Tweaxly

Tweaxly is an AI-powered business intelligence platform for small business owners.

It helps business owners understand their financial data, monitor business performance, track cash flow, detect important changes, understand key business metrics, forecast future trends, and make better business decisions.

## Main Pages

- Home: https://tweaxly.com
- Features: https://tweaxly.com/features
- Pricing: https://tweaxly.com/pricing
- Resources: https://tweaxly.com/resources
